headline: WxCrop paper links weather hazards to county-level crop-loss estimates
summary: A new preprint introduces WxCrop, a workflow that joins dated weather, crop maps, growing calendars and county-level insured-loss records to estimate crop hazard and loss fractions in Florida. The authors report hazard-index discrimination and retrospective loss-model checks, including held-out-year storm losses within 2% in aggregate and county citrus-production ranking correlation of 0.63 across 110 county-seasons. These are author-reported retrospective results; the paper does not establish prospective forecast utility, field-level accuracy or operational benefit.
